failure_modes.name: Repository localization or retrieval misses
failure_modes.description: The graph-based retrieval and reranking pipeline does not consistently identify the files needed for the issue, as indicated by unresolved Django and SymPy probes.

failure_modes.name: Issue-specific diagnosis is insufficiently reliable
failure_modes.description: The system's general repository-level prompting and model reasoning do not reliably translate issue descriptions into a correct implementation diagnosis on harder instances.

failure_modes.name: End-to-end patch execution or validation failure
failure_modes.description: Despite an architecture aimed at repository-level code changes, the default system fails to produce an accepted solution on two of the four recorded probes, reflecting weak execution reliability.

why: The system is clearly aligned with SWE-bench repository-level repair and resolved both recorded Django probes, but its official 44.0% resolve rate and two unresolved probes show that successful reasoning does not generalize reliably. The strongest evidence of weakness is end-to-end execution accuracy, while the structured reranker prompts support only moderate output integrity rather than near-perfect reliability.

runnability.reason: cli entry point plausible; execution still requires SWE-bench task infra
